purpose: Increase the number and domain breadth of difficult general-knowledge transfer cases before drawing model-level conclusions.

selection_policy.rationale: The block spans quantitative medicine, evolutionary biology, power systems, distributed software systems, ML methodology and RAG evaluation. It tests mechanisms, boundary conditions and transfer rather than isolated trivia.

measurement_policy.adaptive_warm_repetitions: Add two warm repetitions only when close or unstable timing could affect a speed-quality conclusion.
measurement_policy.publication_grade_repetitions: Reserve five measured warm runs for finalists or a later publication-grade rerun.
measurement_policy.run_interleaving: Each case is completed as one controlled four-model comparison; case order and within-case model order are frozen below.

before_each_comparison: Verify the Mnemosyn and News-App application workers are stopped.
Inspect running processes rather than inferring application state from open shells or paths.
Explicitly unload every model reported by Ollama.
Confirm Ollama remains empty during the preflight observation window.

analysis_policy.primary_aggregate: Mean final score across all six predeclared cases, retaining invalid and capped outcomes.
secondary_aggregates: Compliant-only mean with compliance rate shown separately
Mean warm wall time and case-level quality-latency Pareto frontiers
